name: Jan
desc: Open-source chat that runs any model, locally or online
desc_zh: 可跑任意模型的开源聊天工具，支持本地与在线
solves: Hosted chat assistants all phone home. Open models can run on your own machine instead, with no account and nothing leaving the device.
solves_zh: 托管的聊天助手都会上报。开源模型可以直接跑在你自己的机器上，不需要账号，数据也不出设备。
best_for: When you want an offline chat on your own machine and will bring your own model.
best_for_zh: 当你想在自己的机器上离线私聊，并且愿意自带模型时。
